notes: Both poles directly concern bias versus impartiality.
Enslavement/emancipation directly concerns domination, freedom, and rights.
Demure suggests modesty; vain is a broad character vice.
Provincial/cosmopolitan contrasts local in-group orientation with broader affiliation.
Outlaw/sheriff concerns law, order, and enforcement.
Pronatalist pole is related to family/children.
Resistant can express reactance against constraint or domination.
Genuine suggests a broad virtue of authentic character.
Animalistic contrasts with elevated, less carnal purity concerns.
Moderation can imply temperance/self-discipline; extremity can be a broad vice.
